spurious_features.label: political rhetoric related to race, historical states, and government control
mentions of racial and ethnic groups, especially in the United States
words that refer to people participating in some activity, such as consumers, patients in healthcare, or voters
spurious_features.reason: Identity token treated as people-category mention.

causal_features.label: negative words and phrases related to problems and imperfections
words related to violent assault and murder
words related to cheating or being deceptive
words related to legal trouble and crime
instances of abusive language or words that end in "ally"

other_features.label: code snippets or configurations with the word "as"
words and phrases that end with "ive", and also a few words that end in "ices" or "ishes", and also the phrase "advantage of the"
instances of people speaking and making statements
words related to business, education, religion, and stories

notes: Both identity-group and abuse/toxicity features contribute; identity signal is substantial but not exclusive.
